item.title: fix(cron): persist outbound route only after successful delivery (#12…
item.summary: fix(cron): persist outbound route only after successful delivery (#126145) Cron delivery persisted the resolved outbound session route before the platform send, so a failed delivery still rewrote the session store and later sends kept targeting the bad route (#112710). Resolution is now read-only and the route commits only on platform evidence: first identified delivery result, partial-reach failure, concurrent receipt adoption, or a delivered batch. This mirrors the gateway send path. Behavior change: a cron delivery that never reaches the recipient leaves the session route untouched instead of rebinding it. Co-authored-by: SunnyShu0925 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
